# l4-schemas

The L4 skills' input and output contracts, `skills/<skill>/{input,output}.schema.json`, beside the skills that name them (bean folio-assistant-kjea). Each skill's `input:`/`output:` front matter is the binding; the published IRI is keyed by skill, so moving here from the root `schemas/skills/` kept every address.

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l4-schemas`, holding `schemas`.
